Demo video

game brief

In game, the player takes on the role of a student at a magical academy who faces the final exam for their Summoning class. Unfortunately, due to inattentiveness in class, their notes are messy, with some parts even missing! This makes achieving a high score a true challenge. Players must use their intelligence to solve puzzles, interpret clues in the notes, and successfully summon mystical magical creatures. Be cautious, as failure will surely provoke the wrath of the stern professor!

game play

The theme of this competition was "Summoning." Since our team lacked members skilled in programming, we opted to create a simple 2D puzzle-solving game. The core gameplay is straightforward: players must use hints from puzzles and notes to deduce the placement of magical materials and the style of the magic circle. Only by placing everything correctly can the summoning succeed.


The gameplay was inspired by the summoning puzzle in Baldur's Gate 3 when entering Raphael's House of Hope. The game features five puzzles, and I was responsible for designing the first one, "Black Cat."

art design

The game's story revolves around the cozy theme of a "magical exam." To match this, I adopted a warm and cute art style for the visuals. Character design was a key focus, including both the protagonist and the summoned creatures. I incorporated elements of the creatures' original concepts (e.g., Beelzebub's identity as the Lord of Flies) but softened the more intimidating aspects to maintain an overall cute and approachable vibe.

Additionally, to enhance the visual appeal, I created small animations for each summoned creature. While being the sole artist meant a heavy workload, I’m glad I managed to complete everything in the end.
